symptom: Engine shakes or runs rough at idle
questions: Does it happen only when stopped, or while driving too?
Is the check-engine light on or flashing?
Did it begin after maintenance, fueling, or a cold start?
warning: A flashing check-engine light may signal catalyst-damaging misfire; reduce load and seek prompt professional assessment.

symptom: Hesitation or loss of power during acceleration
questions: Does it happen at light throttle or hard acceleration?
Is there a flashing check-engine light or reduced-power warning?
Is the symptom new after refueling?
warning: If power loss makes merging or maintaining speed unsafe, stop in a safe location.

symptom: Engine does not crank
questions: Do dashboard lights turn on?
Do you hear one click, repeated clicks, or silence?
Is the shifter fully in Park or Neutral?
warning: Avoid repeated start attempts if cables become hot or smoke appears.

symptom: Engine cranks but does not start
questions: Does it start briefly then stall?
Was the tank recently refilled?
Are any security or immobilizer warnings present?
warning: Do not continue cranking excessively or attempt fuel-system work near ignition sources.

symptom: Engine overheating or high temperature warning
questions: Is the temperature warning currently on?
Do you see steam or coolant leaking?
Are you safely parked with the engine off?
warning: Pull over safely, turn engine off, and allow it to cool. Never open a hot pressurized coolant cap.

symptom: Low engine oil pressure warning
questions: Is the warning red and active?
Is the engine running now?
Is there knocking or unusual noise?
warning: Stop safely and switch the engine off immediately. Avoid driving until oil pressure is checked.

symptom: Brake pedal soft, loss of stopping power, or brake warning
questions: Is braking power reduced now?
Is there fluid leaking or a red brake warning?
Are you safely stopped?
warning: Do not continue driving with impaired braking. Arrange qualified inspection or towing.

symptom: Steering suddenly heavy or steering assistance warning
questions: Can you control the vehicle safely?
Did the steering effort change suddenly?
Is there a steering or battery warning?
warning: If steering control is impaired, stop safely and obtain professional assistance.

symptom: Charging-system or battery warning while driving
questions: Is the warning on while the engine runs?
Are lights dimming or electronics malfunctioning?
Do you hear belt noises?
helpful_evidence: battery voltage engine on and off
warning: Vehicle may stall or fail to restart. Minimize electrical load and stop safely for inspection.

symptom: Check-engine light is on
questions: Is the light steady or flashing?
Is the car shaking, overheating, or losing power?
Can we read stored and pending trouble codes?
warning: A flashing light with rough running needs prompt attention; a code identifies a monitored condition, not a proven failed part.

symptom: Fuel economy is worse than usual
questions: Is the change based on multiple full tanks?
Has your route, speed, weather, or tire pressure changed?
Are there new warning lights?
helpful_evidence: EPA reference MPG for exact configuration
warning: EPA estimates are comparison references, not guaranteed real-world MPG.

symptom: Engine misfire
questions: Is the check-engine light flashing?
Does the misfire occur on cold start, idle, or under load?
Are cylinder-specific codes available?
warning: Avoid prolonged driving with a persistent or flashing-light misfire; it can damage the catalytic converter.

symptom: Air conditioning is not cold
questions: Does the blower move air normally?
Is the failure intermittent or constant?
Does the problem appear at idle only?
warning: Refrigerant system service requires appropriate equipment and qualified handling.

symptom: Heater produces little or no heat
questions: Does the engine reach its normal operating temperature?
Does airflow change when you switch temperature settings?
Is coolant level low after cooling?
warning: If combined with overheating or coolant leakage, stop and address cooling safety first.

symptom: Vibration increases with vehicle speed
questions: Is it in the steering wheel, seat, or whole body?
Does it happen while braking or only moving?
Have tires or wheels been serviced recently?
warning: Stop driving if a tire is damaged, loose, or at risk of failure.

symptom: Shudder or vibration during braking
questions: Is vibration felt in brake pedal or steering wheel?
Does it worsen from highway speeds?
Is braking power normal?
warning: Any reduced stopping ability requires immediate inspection, not continued testing.

symptom: Engine revs rise without matching acceleration
questions: Is it during a gear shift or while already in gear?
Are there transmission warnings?
Is there a burning smell?
possible_systems: fluid level or condition depending on design
helpful_evidence: reported gear vs commanded gear if supported
warning: Avoid continued driving with severe slipping or overheating; have it inspected.

symptom: Coolant leak or frequent coolant top-ups
questions: Do you see a puddle and where?
Has a temperature warning appeared?
Is the engine currently hot?
warning: Do not remove the cap while hot. If overheating, stop the engine.

symptom: Oil leak or oil smell
questions: Are there drops on the ground or smoke from the engine bay?
Is an oil pressure or oil level warning active?
Was there recent service?
warning: If low oil pressure or visible smoke develops, stop and switch the engine off.

symptom: Tire-pressure warning
questions: Is a tire visibly low or damaged?
Did temperatures change sharply?
Does the warning identify one wheel?
helpful_evidence: cold tire pressure measured with gauge
warning: If tire appears flat or damaged, do not continue driving. Use the vehicle manufacturer's placard pressure.

symptom: Rough engine running after a cold start
questions: Does it smooth out when warm?
Is the check-engine light active?
What is the outside temperature?
helpful_evidence: coolant and intake temperature before start
warning: Do not assume normal cold-start behavior explains a flashing check-engine light.

symptom: Unusual exhaust smoke
questions: Is it white, blue, or dark, and does it persist after warm-up?
Is there coolant or oil loss?
Does the engine run roughly?
warning: Heavy smoke, overheating, or loss of power requires stopping and inspection; do not diagnose solely by color.

symptom: Intermittent electrical faults or many warning lights
questions: Do warnings appear together or after starting?
Has the battery been replaced or disconnected?
Are there charging-system faults?
warning: Multiple warnings may share a low-voltage cause but should not be dismissed without diagnosis.

symptom: Engine stalls while driving
questions: Does it restart immediately?
Does it happen at a stop or while moving?
Are there fuel or electrical warnings?
warning: Stalling in traffic is hazardous. Safely pull over and arrange inspection rather than repeated road tests.
